title: Leviathans
description: Very real, but still sources of myth and legend to most of the wildsea's inhabitants - the titanic creatures whose movements shape the waves themselves.
inPlay: Leviathans are not fights to be won - they are events. Give them a limit of 21 boxes or more, make their aspects change as tracks fill, and treat encounters with them as multi-stage, re-occurring set pieces.

hazards.name: Perpetual Flowering Leviathan
hazards.summary: The Orchid Scar: reputed to be the first leviathan ever conquered, and the second, and the third. Half-mile petals unfurl impossibly from a fist-sized bud, and as one instance dies another is already budding nearby.

hazards.name: Brutish Leviathan Beast
hazards.summary: Old Ornail, the squirrel to end all squirrels: it crawls up from the depths every autumn, stomach growling as it prepares for winter, and any sufficiently large food source is fair game.

hazards.name: Wingless Avian Leviathan
hazards.summary: The Oilcrow: a rolling slick of filth, feathers, and sickness, a bird large enough to catch a ship, with crezzerin run rampant through its body.

hazards.name: Spectral Leviathan Phenomenon
hazards.summary: The Spirit of Industry: a belief and an ancestral memory given almost-form - the bite of chainsaws, the chopping of axes, the sound of sawmills. It has no shape or physicality, no limbs to shackle or gears to clog.

hazards.name: Leviathan Force of Nature
hazards.summary: Living storms: leviathan-sized weather systems with a volt-bound consciousness, though the extent of their intelligence is very much up for debate.

hazards.name: Tentacular Insect Leviathan
hazards.summary: The Isogast: a shelled insect leviathan whose slime-trail network and many tentacles serve multiple functions, sensing the world and dealing damage alike.

hazards.name: Ancient Salvage-Shelled Behemoth
hazards.summary: The Terrapex: once a decade or so the tangle shifts and ironroots topple as this miles-long beast, its shell built of pre-verdant architecture, struggles its way to the surface.

hazards.name: Mesmeric Leviathan Fox Beast
hazards.summary: The Snare: a leviathan so beautiful that it hurts to hunt - at least, that's how the rumours go. Leviathaneers return with wild stories and injuries inflicted by their own crewmates.

hazards.name: Scaled Leviathan Beast
hazards.summary: The Queen Beneath: an archive collector of wealth to such a degree that even a rage Writling would be taken aback, but slow and smouldering, tempered with patience.
